intro: The long form modifies a noun; the short one usually works as a preacher: утверждд нный план / план утверждд н.

bloques.titulo: The long form modifies a noun; the short one usually works as a preacher: утверждд нный план / план утверждд н.
texto: The long form modifies a noun; the short one usually works as a preacher: утверждд нный план / план утверждд н.
The short form is consistent with gender and number; in the past there is был, была, были.

frases.es: La comisión ha tomado la decisión.
frases.en: The committee has taken the decision.

frases.es: La decisión adoptada se publicó por la mañana.
frases.en: The decision was published in the morning.

bloques.pregunta: What form works as an attribute in «the decision taken»?

opciones.explicacion: Принятое directly modifies the noun решение.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

opciones.texto: The committee has taken the decision.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The decision was published in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.traduccion: The decision was published in the morning.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
